record.question: Severe acute malnutrition (SAM) in children is defined when the weight-for-height/length is below:
options: - 1 Standard deviation of the WHO standards
- 2 Standard deviation of the WHO standards
- 3 Standard deviation of the WHO standards
- 4 Standard deviation of the WHO standards
record.explanation: Answer C: - 3 Standard deviation of the WHO standards. Severe acute malnutrition by weight-for-height/length is defined as below −3 standard deviations of the WHO Child Growth Standards (or other criteria such as low MUAC or edema). Reference: https://www.nhm.gov.in/images/pdf/programmes/child-health/guidelines/operational_guidelines_on_fbmc_with_sam.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
